sourcePin.note: Local commit/tree verified. Remote commit/tree association comes from root-coverage.json and parent message; no network fetch was performed.

methodology.operation: Only existing evidence manifests, path inventories and current bytes for hashes were read. No new semantic source review, tests or builds. Only this JSON written.
methodology.deduplication: One files[] row per physical repository path. Every direct manual attestation retains manifest/JSON pointer, recorded hash and exact classification. A matching full attestation supersedes matching targeted for current extent; stale evidence cannot upgrade it.
methodology.fullDefinition: An explicit full/manualFull/active_path_full_review/legacy_boundary_full_source_read attestation whose SHA or pinned root tree matches current bytes. It is not dynamic branch coverage.
methodology.targetedDefinition: Explicit targeted or selected review; conservatively also unspecified logic/specification extent. No inferred full upgrade from test passes, inventories or generated-byte comparisons.
methodology.derivedEvidence: Derived coverageUnion, shared-dependency-coverage and funded-boundary-coverage rows are freshness-checked but do not independently promote extent. Test hashes and generated/wordlist verification remain nonmanual evidence.
methodology.assetDefinition: Binary TTF files are hashed assets, not claimed full manual source reads.

fundedAppModuleCrosscheck.method: Actual parent Vite renderedLength>0 app module list. Query suffixes retained as module IDs, removed only to locate and hash physical asset bytes. A full file read does not mean every export survives tree shaking.

components.inventoryClarification: The component directory contains 34 source files: 32 TSX and two .ts alias adapters. Counting those as 34 TSX would be inaccurate. The 32 TSX components plus the two App roots separately form 34 TSX roots/components. main.tsx and the lib I18nProvider are additional TSX sources.
